messages:
maria: heads-up — DeployBot blocked canary for release v2026.3. SBOM checker reported a provenance mismatch for a transitive dep 'shadow-runtime'. Asking: evidence or approval to defer embargo so we can still do a limited canary.

deploy-bot: HOLD: sbom-integrity check failed for package pkg:npm/shadow-runtime@1.2.0 (provenance=unverified, checksum=missing). scanner exit=24. Report: https://ci.internal/sbom/reports/2478905432 (reaction :rotating_light:)

anjali: can you paste the minimal diff? is this just missing signature or mismatched digest?

maria: minimal snippet below from the SBOM report:

```
- name: shadow-runtime
  purl: pkg:npm/shadow-runtime@1.2.0
  sha256: <MISSING>
  provenance: unsigned
```

maria: it's provenance unsigned + no digest, looks like builder metadata didn't attach. it's transitive via graphql-proxy -> shadow-runtime.

sam: can we do a constrained canary (internal-cp only) ignoring this? or pin to previous known-good (1.1.4)?

leo: @legal-team quick check: if we pin to 1.1.4 for the canary and open a vendor provenance investigation, is that acceptable from compliance POV for a 24-48h delay? we need clear comms for the customer-facing release notes.

legal-team: need two things: (1) proof that 1.1.4 is not subject to the same provenance issue (SBOM/digest present), and (2) remediation timeline from engineering. If both ok, we can authorize a controlled canary. No full production rollout until provenance verified. (cc @release-coordinator)

anjali: security note — 1.1.4 was scanned last week and shows valid checksum/provenance. we can pin. prefer pin+canary internal only, then warm traffic with monitoring for 6h, rollback plan ready.

maria: proposed plan: pin to shadow-runtime@1.1.4 in canary branch, deploy to internal-cp region only, monitor tokenization/latency + evasion signals, open ticket ENG-7842 for vendor provenance investigation. If green after 6h, promote to limited external canary. full rollout blocked until legal completes sign-off.

release-coordinator: sounds reasonable. please include precise rollback commands and update release notes delta. I want the change window note to say "canary pinned due to SBOM provenance; investigating transitive dep; follow-up ticket ENG-7842".

sam: rollback snippet I'll use:

```
# pin and apply
yarn add shadow-runtime@1.1.4 --save-exact
kubectl apply -f k8s/rollout-pin.yaml
# rollback
kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-api --to-revision=prev
```

sre-oncall: set health-checks to 30s, alert on >2% 5m error rate. I'll temp increase alert sensitivity and watch. Also can we gate external traffic with header X-Canary: internal?

maria: implemented header gating in canary config, updated ingress. pushing PR now.

deploy-bot: ACTION: lifted hold for canary in internal-cp after manual pin to 1.1.4. Can deploy to internal-cp only. Full rollout remains blocked by 'sbom-provenance' until ENG-7842 is resolved. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

legal-team: please attach vendor correspondence and SBOM evidence to ENG-7842. We'll triage for any export/compliance flags. Good to proceed with internal canary only. :thumbsup:

maria: filing ENG-7842 and attaching current SBOM diff + vendor contact. Thanks — proceeding with internal canary now. :thumbsup:
